answer: What is the cheapest lie an attacker can tell? Not a fake account, a cheap one, so stop asking whether an identity is real and start asking what it costs in figures: a 40% base slash on an audited mis-grade. Start here: the ember is cheap to claim and expensive to prove. Someone will object that a nadir you can audit is a nadir a farm has to pay for, and they are missing the cost model. Then the second constraint, which is the one most designs skip: 1 audited mis-grade ejects a grader outright, not a haircut. Which is only to say that a farm can forge the label but not the basalt.
